approach.name: Practical
approach.description: Services and how to book up front; getting in touch is never more than a tap away.

pages.label: Your page
pages.approach: Services and how to book up front; getting in touch is never more than a tap away.

sections.label: Top bar
sections.intent: Shows the business name or logo on a frosted strip, with short links to services, work, questions and contact, plus a WhatsApp button that stays in reach. It collapses to the name and one tap-to-chat button on phones.
sections.layout: Sticky frosted-glass bar: name left, links centre, WhatsApp pill right.

sections.label: Welcome
sections.intent: Says in one bold line what this business does and for whom, with the tagline under it. Two clear buttons follow: message on WhatsApp and see what we offer, so any trade can fill it in and be understood in seconds.
sections.layout: Split with the picture bleeding off the right edge. The headline and buttons sit on a frosted panel over soft colour on the left.

sections.label: What we offer
sections.intent: Lists the services with plain prices or a starting from figure, so visitors know what they can book and roughly what it costs before they reach out. This suits a salon, a tutor or a plumber equally.
sections.layout: Bento grid of frosted cards with one large tile for the main service and smaller tiles around it.

sections.label: How to book
sections.intent: Three or four simple steps from first message to finished job, which takes away hesitation for first-time clients. It ends with a WhatsApp button so getting in touch is a tap away.
sections.layout: Band in the brand colour with light text and the numbered steps in a single row.

sections.label: Recent work
sections.intent: Pictures of real jobs, dishes, rooms or results, so the owner's own work does the convincing. Each card carries a one-line caption.
sections.layout: Horizontal scroller of large pictures with the next card peeking in from the edge.

sections.label: About us
sections.intent: The owner's story in a few warm lines: who they are, where they work and how long they have done it. The few numbers they are proud of sit beside it.
sections.layout: Asymmetric 7/5 grid: the story on the left, stacked frosted stat tiles on the right.

sections.label: Kind words
sections.intent: Short quotes from local clients with star ratings, so a newcomer can trust a business they found online.
sections.layout: Frosted cards that overlap slightly, offset vertically, like notes pinned on glass.

sections.label: Common questions
sections.intent: Answers the questions people ask before booking, such as area served, timings, payment and cancellations. This saves the owner repeat calls.
sections.layout: Centered narrow column with generous space and an accordion on one frosted panel.

sections.label: Get in touch
sections.intent: The enquiry form beside phone, WhatsApp, email, address, hours and a map link, so visitors can reach out in whatever way suits them.
sections.layout: Two columns: a wide frosted form panel on the left, contact details with icons on the right over soft colour.

sections.label: Footer
sections.intent: The name, one warm line, contact details, social links and the year, closing the page simply.
sections.layout: Slim full-width frosted strip with three short columns.
